description: Keetch-Byram Drought Index (KBDI) in Mekong Region is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Mekong. Coverage: the Mekong region (Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam). The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Mekong. Its tags are Drought, SDG13 Climate Action. It offers 1 resource(s) in wms. The portal shows 2021-05-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
